capabilities: create a new vault from the current one via a command
copy the settings folder (.obsidian or a custom-named one)
preserve the vault's folder structure without note contents
selectively copy contents of chosen folders such as Templates or Snippets
set a default location and name for new vaults
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to spin up a new vault that reuses an existing vault's settings and folder layout without dragging along all notes.
summary: Vault cloning tool that creates a new vault by copying settings and folder structure without note contents.
